# Clínica Hispana Cruz 2 - Houston, TX

## About
Clínica Hispana Cruz 2 is a Hispanic medical clinic located in Houston, Texas. We provide professional healthcare services 100% in Spanish for the Hispanic community.

## Location
- Address: 13331 Kuykendahl Rd Ste 128, Houston, TX 77090
- Phone: (281) 789-0484
- Email: clinicahcruz2@gmail.com

## Hours
- Monday - Sunday: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM

## Services
We offer comprehensive medical services including:

### General Medicine
- Diabetes, Hypertension & Cholesterol Care (/servicios/condiciones-cronicas)
- Thyroid Testing & Treatment (/servicios/tiroides)
- Allergy Testing & Treatment (/servicios/alergias)
- Flu & COVID Testing and Respiratory Illness Care (/servicios/enfermedades-respiratorias)
- Men's Health Exams: PSA & Testosterone (/servicios/salud-hombre)

### Women's Health
- Gynecology Care: Pap Smear & Cultures (/servicios/ginecologia)
- Pregnancy Testing & Confirmation (/servicios/prueba-embarazo)
- Contraceptive Methods (/servicios/anticonceptivos)
- Subdermal Implant Removal (/servicios/extraccion-implantes)

### Exams & Certificates
- School & Sports Physical Exams (/servicios/examen-fisico-escolar)
- Alcohol & Drug Testing (/servicios/examen-alcohol-drogas)
- DOT Physical Exam - CDL License (/servicios/examen-dot)
- Immigration Medical Exam I-693 (/servicios/examenes-inmigracion)

### Lab & Testing
- Blood Tests | Lab (/servicios/examenes-sangre)
- Stool Tests (/servicios/examen-heces)
- Strep Test (/servicios/prueba-strep)
- Tuberculosis (TB) Test (/servicios/prueba-tuberculosis)
- Sexually Transmitted Disease (STD) Testing (/servicios/enfermedades-transmision-sexual)
- Electrocardiogram (EKG) (/servicios/electrocardiograma)
- Ultrasound & Sonography (/servicios/ultrasonido)

### Treatments
- Urinalysis & Urinary Infection Treatment (/servicios/infecciones-urinarias)
- Flu and Tetanus (Tdap) Vaccines (/servicios/vacunas)
- Vitamin IV Therapy (/servicios/sueros-vitaminados)
- Wound Suturing (/servicios/suturas-heridas)
- Wound Care (/servicios/curacion-heridas)
- Minor Surgery (/servicios/cirugias-menores)
- Abscess Drainage (/servicios/drenaje-abscesos)
- Ingrown Toenail Removal (/servicios/unas-encarnadas)
- Pharmacy (/servicios/farmacia)

## Languages
- Spanish (Primary)
- English

## Payment
No insurance required. We offer affordable, transparent self-pay pricing and accept cash and cards. Uninsured patients welcome.
